identityCompatibility: whois does not include MachineAuthorized for peers; authorization uses Serve admission plus exact UserProfile ID/login and Node.User, rejecting tagged nodes.

deployment.sourceOfAdmissionEvidence: actual authenticated Tailscale request, not injected loopback identity headers

limitations: Physical iPhone Safari was not directly exercised; clean no-cookie HTTP and WebSocket were exercised through the same Tailscale entry point.
Tailscale authorization and connectivity must remain valid.
The DSH token/cookie exchange contract and startup log availability must be retained across DSH upgrades.
